title: Auto-harvest CI DB-proof evidence into runtime_proof; fix proof-repair verifier-object clobbering

sha_binding.verified_source_note: 22a1d70d is this branch's real implementation commit after a second rebase onto origin/main. The first rebase (18f2d258, now superseded) was conflict-free; a second rebase was required when origin/main advanced again mid-lane (UTV2-1633 db-role migration + a ghost-lane reconcile), which produced a genuine package.json conflict on the test:ops script entry -- resolved by unioning both additions (this lane's ci-db-proof-harvest.test.ts and UTV2-1633's reporting-reader-role-guard test), never dropping either. Re-confirmed via `git merge-base HEAD origin/main` equalling `git rev-parse origin/main` post-rebase, and pnpm type-check + the four modified/added test files (151/151) re-run green on the new head. The authoritative binding is the PR's squash-merge SHA, written post-merge by post-merge-lane-close.yml via `ops:proof-generate --merge-sha`, which this lane's own auto-harvest addition also runs against.

verifier.method: Every mechanical claim below (queries.length, row_counts values, verifier-preservation diffs) is asserted directly in committed node:test files against real fixture bytes captured from a genuine, already-merged CI run -- not narrated. The row_counts cross-validation specifically compares this lane's mechanically-derived output against a DIFFERENT lane's (UTV2-1399's) independently hand-authored evidence.json, which is the closest available independent verification for a governance-tooling change with no separate human reviewer in this session.

It does NOT constitute a live runtime_proof for THIS lane's own T1 gate -- that is whatever CI's real staging-db-proof job for this PR's own head produces, read back by this lane's own new auto-harvest mechanism against its own merge SHA, same as any other lane.
verifier.independence_note: The central claims are checked both directions where meaningful: buildRuntimeProofRowCounts(realJobLog) is asserted to equal EXACTLY the row_counts UTV2-1399's own repair recorded by hand from the same real run (scripts/ops/proof-generate.test.ts / scripts/ops/ci-db-proof-harvest.test.ts), and mergeVerifierIdentity is asserted to reproduce the pre-fix bare-object behavior when invoked on the OLD code path's exact fixture shape, then the NEW preserving behavior on the same fixture with the fix applied.
